features.title: Premium leather with a timeless touch
features.text: Upholstered in rich leather, this sofa combines a luxurious feel with durability, ensuring it stands the test of time in both style and comfort.

features.title: Built to last with sturdy construction
features.text: Made with a strong wooden frame, this sofa is built to withstand everyday use while maintaining its polished look and premium comfort.

features.title: Sink-in comfort with pocket springs
features.text: Pocket spring and foam cushioning work together to create a plush seating experience, offering just the right balance of support and softness.

features.title: Chesterfield-inspired details for added elegance
features.text: Deep-button tufting gives the sofa a classic, sophisticated aesthetic that blends seamlessly into both traditional and modern settings.

features.title: Raised design for effortless cleaning
features.text: Elevated on sturdy legs, this sofa makes it simple to clean underneath and keeps your space looking polished and tidy.
